records.jp: ところで何の用事なの？<CR>こんなところに来たいなんて
records.en_original: Why did you bring me all the way out here, anyway?
records.en: Why did you bring me all the way out here, anyway?

records.jp: 確認したいことがあって
records.en_original: I wanted to check something.
records.en: I wanted to check something.

records.jp: 何を？
records.en_original: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: すぐ終わるから
records.en_original: It'll be quick.
records.en: It'll be quick.

records.jp: ちょっと！　言ってよ！
records.en_original: What is it? Tell me!
records.en: What is it? Tell me!

records.jp: 言ってもついてきてくれる？
records.en_original: Will you still come with me if I tell you?
records.en: Will you still come with me if I tell you?

records.jp: はぁ～……<CR>絶対ロクなことじゃない
records.en_original: *Sigh* It's definitely something weird.
records.en: *Sigh* It's definitely something weird.

records.jp: （そう言いながらもついてきてはくれるんだ）
records.en_original: (That doesn't seem to be stopping her, though.)
records.en: (That doesn't seem to be stopping her, though.)

records.jp: かわいい猫がいるって聞いて
records.en_original: I heard there's a cute kitty around here.
records.en: I heard there's a cute kitty around here.

records.jp: 本当に？
records.en_original: Really?
records.en: Really?

records.jp: うん、ホントホント
records.en_original: Yeah, I swear!
records.en: Yeah, I swear!

records.jp: やっぱり嘘でしょ！　帰る！
records.en_original: I knew you were lying! I'm leaving!
records.en: I knew you were lying! I'm leaving!

records.jp: まぁまぁ、そう言わず。<CR>本当に猫が来るかもしれないじゃん
records.en_original: Hey now, you never know. A cat might actually show up.
records.en: Hey now, you never know. A cat might actually show up.

records.jp: さらっと認めてるし
records.en_original: So you admit you were lying.
records.en: So you admit you were lying.

records.jp: 何もないね。普通の井戸って感じ
records.en_original: Huh, just an ordinary well. There's nothing in there.
records.en: Huh, just an ordinary well. There's nothing in there.

records.jp: 何かあったら困るでしょ
records.en_original: I'd be worried if there was.
records.en: I'd be worried if there was.

records.jp: それもそっか。あはは
records.en_original: Yeah, I guess that's true. Ahaha.
records.en: Yeah, I guess that's true. Ahaha.

records.jp: もういい？<CR>帰りたいんだけど
records.en_original: Are we done? I'd like to go back.
records.en: Are we done? I'd like to go back.

records.jp: ごめんごめん。<CR>行こっか
records.en_original: Sorry, sorry! You're right, let's go.
records.en: Sorry, sorry! You're right, let's go.

records.jp: わっ
records.en_original: Boo!
records.en: Boo!

records.en_original: Aah!!
records.en: Aah!!

records.jp: びっくりした？
records.en_original: Were you scared?
records.en: Were you scared?

records.jp: そういうの全っ然面白くないから。<CR>本当に、やめて
records.en_original: Cut it out! That's not even a little funny.
records.en: Cut it out! That's not even a little funny.

records.jp: ……ご、ごめん
records.en_original: S-Sorry...
records.en: S-Sorry...

records.jp: 大丈夫、大丈夫。<CR>何回かここに来てるけど変なもの見たことないから
records.en_original: It's fiiiine! I've been here plenty of times, and nothing strange has ever happened.
records.en: It's fiiiine! I've been here plenty of times, and nothing strange has ever happened.

records.jp: ほら、こうやって手つないでるし。ね？
records.en_original: And look, we're holding hands, so nothing can hurt us.
records.en: And look, we're holding hands, so nothing can hurt us.

records.jp: 別に怖がってるわけじゃないし
records.en_original: It's not like I'm scared or anything...
records.en: It's not like I'm scared or anything...

records.jp: （にしては手ちぎれそうなんだけど）
records.en_original: (I'd believe her if she wasn't crushing my hand.)
records.en: (I'd believe her if she wasn't crushing my hand.)

records.jp: あまり聞きたくないんだけど……<CR>何か目撃談でもあるの？
records.en_original: I'm not sure I want to know, but... Have you heard any stories about this place?
records.en: I'm not sure I want to know, but... Have you heard any stories about this place?

records.jp: 伶那さんってさ、時々ここから水取ってきてるよね
records.en_original: You sometimes come here to get water, don't you, Rena?
records.en: You sometimes come here to get water, don't you, Rena-san?

records.jp: そうだね。料理班の手伝いでたまに
records.en_original: Yeah, sometimes, to help the cooking team.
records.en: Yeah, sometimes, to help the cooking team.

records.jp: なんか変なもの見たことある？
records.en_original: Have you ever seen anything strange?
records.en: Have you ever seen anything strange?

records.jp: えっ！？　な、ないに決まってるでしょ！
records.en_original: What?! O-of course not!
records.en: What?! O-of course not!

records.jp: 変な声聞いたりとか
records.en_original: Heard any strange voices...?
records.en: Heard any strange voices...?

records.jp: ない！
records.en_original: No!
records.en: No!

records.jp: ほんと～？　<CR>他の子からはそういう話、聞いたんだけどな
records.en_original: Are you suuuure? I've heard the other girls have, though.
records.en: Are you suuuure? I've heard the other girls have, though.

records.jp: ええっ！？
records.en_original: What?!
records.en: What?!

records.jp: よかったね、伶那さん。<CR>霊感なくて
records.en_original: You're lucky, Rena. That you can't communicate with the dead.
records.en: You're lucky, Rena-san. That you can't communicate with the dead.

records.jp: よくない！<CR>そんなこと言われたら気になっちゃうじゃない！
records.en_original: What are you talking about?! That just freaks me out even more!
records.en: What are you talking about?! That just freaks me out even more!

records.jp: 星崎さん、次に汲みに行く時はついてきて！
records.en_original: You better come with me next time I get water, Hoshizaki!
records.en: You better come with me next time I get water, Hoshizaki-san!

records.jp: 仕方ないなあ
records.en_original: I guess I have to.
records.en: I guess I have to.

records.jp: 仕方なくない！<CR>怖い話をした人の義務！
records.en_original: It's your own fault for telling scary stories!
records.en: It's your own fault for telling scary stories!

records.jp: はいはい、わかったわかった
records.en_original: Fine, fine. You win.
records.en: Fine, fine. You win.

records.jp: どうしよっかな～
records.en_original: Hmm... Maybe I will, maybe I won't.
records.en: Hmm... Maybe I will, maybe I won't.

records.jp: ……いじわる
records.en_original: ...You're the worst.
records.en: ...You're the worst.

records.jp: ごめんごめん。<CR>ついていきますって
records.en_original: Sorry, sorry. I'll go with you, don't worry!
records.en: Sorry, sorry. I'll go with you, don't worry!

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
